question: Can literal PCFI propagation inside a public GraphPFN, modulated by context-derived PFN states, improve classification over external PCFI, fixed internal PCFI and a strictly label-blind router?
data: Unchanged size-restricted official GraphPFN graph/SCM/task generator: requested192 nodes, avg degree4-12, raw features8-16 (actual size may differ), binary/multiclass at most4 classes. Same generator family, fresh graph seeds; not unseen-schema or real-graph transfer. Query32 from heldout official split; context at most4/class from original training split. Do not force nonzero observations or resample masks.
input: Same observed-only per-column RMS, no recentering, +/-10 observed clip, explicit original mask, native feature pairs, no PCA. Every method gets identical graph and context. Odd-dimensional zero padding is marked observed, excluded from physical observation counts and primary missing-query membership. Hidden feature values and query labels are not predictor inputs.
pcfi: Literal author-default alpha.9/beta1 PCFI. Self-looped undirected adjacency, channel shortest-path pseudo-confidence c=.9^distance, weighted row-normalized inter-node propagation, observed values clamped at every one of100 iterations, one original cross-channel correlation correction at the end, final +/-10 clip. Original no-source/unreachable distance0 convention retained. c is not a calibrated probability. NumPy/SciPy reference and torch implementation must agree before locking.
placement: All methods execute exactly100 propagation steps, one correlation correction and one12-layer PFN pass. External runs all100+correlation before embedding. Internal arms split into25-step blocks before layers0/3/6/9, correlation only after the fourth block. Updated numeric encoder increments E(U_new)-E(U_old) are added to feature tokens while keeping PFN/label states. This interleaving does not algebraically equal external PCFI even when router=0.
router: Shared symmetric14->32->1 SiLU edge/cell MLP; bounded log multiplier log2*tanh(raw), zero final layer initialization. Scores held constant within each25-step block. Structural10 fields: endpoint value sum/absolute difference, confidence sum/difference, mask sum/difference, degree sum/difference, block index/3, observed-column fraction. Context4 fields: class-prototype affinity of current PFN feature+label tokens, endpoint max-support product, mean normalized entropy and entropy difference. Class prototypes use only context labels; feature-pair representation shared by its two coordinates. No learned class/relation ID table, no numeric innovation or learned correlation matrix.
label_blind: Identical router parameter count/initialization; all four context/PFN-derived fields are identically zero and the router never reads PFN hidden states or labels. Main classifier still receives context labels. Its numeric trajectory and router depend only on observed values/mask/topology. Context-vs-blind tests the entire context/PFN-feedback input path, not labels alone with hidden representation otherwise held equal. Some input weights in blinded fields are inactive; do not claim identical effective feature use.
public_model: Same public GraphPFN1.3/LimiX initialization, original frozen transformer policy, trained graph adapters/feature encoder/label decoder, plus the same mask embedding and generic TokenControl before0/3/6/9 in all four methods. Context/blind add only513 router parameters; report counts. Common base and common adapters initialize identically within a seed. Context/blind initial predictions equal internal_fixed.
learning: Fresh256 train episodes =64 graphs x4 settings. Each seed uses one permutation of all256,256 successful AdamW updates,batch1,query CE only. Base LR.00003,new LR.001,weight_decay.01,clip1,16-step warmup/cosine. Finite-gradient scaling retries reuse same episode and do not count as successful updates. Final checkpoint only, no target fitting, auxiliary loss, reconstruction or temperature tuning.
development: Four separate dev graphs: numerical parity, poison/clamp/permutation tests, one discarded optimizer smoke step per arm. Verify actual train-step helper and checkpoint reload before design lock. Lock model/config/source and train/dev manifests before generating final test graphs. Record public checkpoint and imported infrastructure hashes.
primary: Accuracy on queries with no physical observed features, context4/class, average uniform_nodes90/99.5 and clustered_nodes90/99.5. All64 fresh base graphs, three fixed training seeds. Per-query metric within episode, four episodes and seeds within graph, then5000 paired graph bootstrap. Context must beat external, internal_fixed and label_blind, each95CI lower>0. NLL/Brier, all queries and individual settings are separate secondary results.
guard: Full-feature accuracy noninferiority to external within2%p:95CI lower>-.02. Failure to establish guard is not proof of collapse. Context+fixed initial equality and full-observed numeric invariance are implementation checks, not trained-accuracy guarantees.
cost: After training workers finish, measure CPU visible input to CPU probabilities on sameRTX3090,5 warmups/30 repeats. Include confidence/distance preprocessing plus100 propagation steps, one correlation correction and onePFN pass. Loading/bank I/O excluded, external GPU load uncontrolled. End-to-end cost differs from training budget. Report train/development/preparation separately.
stop: Require primary and full-feature guard before expansion. Preserve placement-only or weak-baseline improvements separately. No post-test rescue by extra steps/loss/head/temperature/updates. No claim of real-graph improvement, calibrated feature posterior, paper novelty or all PCFI/PFN integration being impossible. Prior generic MLP refiner failure is a separate implementation.
